theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_wc_dense_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (D : Set (TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (s : ℝ), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ s) → |S i ω| ≤ c * s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsCompact K ∧ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K ∧ (∀ k, ωs k ∈ D) ∧ (∀ k, tsupport (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) atTop) → (∀ δ ∈ D, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => S i δ) atTop (𝓝 L)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => S i ω) atTop (𝓝 L)
